qwen3.scope: Official Qwen3-VL family cookbook, with example API model qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct; candidate for pinned local 8B, NOT exact-checkpoint conformance evidence.
qwen3.prompt: Single-category substitution into cells 8-10 every-instance family. Same template on positive, absent and multiple cases; no GT or expected count in prompt.
qwen3.native_structure: JSON array; each object has bbox_2d and label; one and multiple supported. Candidate deliberately rejects singleton object, fences, extras, prose and repaired/truncated JSON.
qwen3.coordinate_order: Executable cell 4 indexes x at 0/2 and y at 1/3. Its y-first docstring conflicts with code; cell 12 x1,y1,x2,y2 format agrees with code. Use xyxy, explicitly do not follow stale docstring.
qwen3.scale: Cell 0 specifies relative 0..1000; cell 4 divides by 1000 and multiplies current displayed image width/height. No resized_w computation. D4 is componentwise /1000 with no rounding, reordering or clipping.
qwen3.preprocessing_relation: Normalized fractions of the complete image axes, independent of resized image dimensions in the cookbook; no crop/tile/letterbox remapping authorized. Local official processor only; exact pinned model conformance remains to be qualified.
qwen3.label: Exact category string; no aliases or model-created descriptions substituted.
qwen3.absence_evidence_limit: Cells 8-10 say negative categories are skipped, but do not specify serialization when every requested category is absent. No all-absent sample/contract found in inspected cookbook/README. [] is BLOCKED, not successful zero.
qwen3.upstream_permissiveness_not_adopted: Plotting helpers strip fences, use literal_eval, repair truncation, wrap singleton objects and reorder reversed axes. These are visualization conveniences, not candidate grammar.

paligemma.scope: Official PaliGemma 1 model-ID-level decoder, supported by merged D9R7 accepted normalization and separately pinned tokenizer/processor metadata. No new exact-revision execution claim.
paligemma.prompt: detect {label} passed to processor; native task suffix ends with one LF supplied by build_string_from_input. No double newline.
paligemma.native_structure: Detection-only strict subset: four adjacent ASCII locNNNN tokens, one space, exact label; repeated with semicolon-space or space-semicolon-space. No prefix/suffix prose, trailing separator, segmentation tokens or unmatched text.
paligemma.multiple_evidence: extract_objs iterates and appends every four-token detection. Multiple support is sourced independently of any historical failed response.
paligemma.coordinates: Native yxyx integer loc0000..loc1023; D4 xyxy = [x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max]/1024. Max is 1023/1024, never rescaled to 1. No clipping or pixel-rounding.
paligemma.preprocessing_relation: Pinned slow SigLIP whole-image resize to 448x448, no crop; demo scales normalized axes to original width/height. No 448 divisor or inverse aspect-ratio correction.
paligemma.label: Exact query label; disable upstream unique_labels renaming and reject mismatches.
paligemma.absence_evidence_limit: extract_objs returns no boxes on empty/no-match text but this is permissive parser behavior, not a documented valid target-absent model response. No strict empty/EOS-only semantics in inspected sources or merged audit.
paligemma.upstream_permissiveness_not_adopted: No unmatched text, optional anonymous labels, segmentation, unique-label renaming or no-match-to-empty success.
